title: Bevel download dock
description: A floating get-the-app prompt. On desktop a small dark card with a QR code and two lines sits in the bottom-right corner and fades out over the first screen of scrolling. On phones a white rounded banner (app icon, name, tagline, stars and a dark pill) slides up from the bottom while the visitor scrolls back up.
notes: fixed: place it once on a page, anywhere
the desktop fade is a CSS scroll timeline (no JavaScript); the phone banner's show-on-scroll-up needs JavaScript
